assets.subject: a giant dungeon rat the size of a dog, matted grey-brown fur, bared yellow teeth, pink scarred tail, red beady eyes, crouching ready to bite
a giant hairy dungeon spider, dark brown body with bone-white markings, eight legs spread, glowing amber eyes, dripping fangs
an ancient mummy wrapped in tattered yellowed bandages, one arm stretched forward, dark hollow eye sockets with a faint ember glow, a cracked golden amulet on its chest
a skeleton jailer (the turnkey) in a rusty chainmail vest, holding up a big iron ring of golden keys in one bony hand and a lantern in the other
a skeleton warrior in a dented iron helmet and breastplate, raising a notched sword, holding a round wooden shield, glowing ember eyes
a skeleton king on a bone throne fragment, tall golden crown with red gems, tattered purple royal cloak, holding a great axe, cold blue glowing eyes
the Fallen: a spectral undead knight, translucent pale blue ghostly armour and a torn cape, a cursed sword, a hovering skull face under the helm, wisps of ghost-light
the dungeon dragon, the final boss: a hulking dark red dragon with ember-glowing cracks on its scales, horns, spread bat wings, smoke from its nostrils, coiled around a pile of gold
a plain adventurer with no special skills: a young traveller in a brown leather jerkin and a short cloak, holding a burning torch and a simple short sword
Horan the Warrior: a broad, battle-scarred veteran in heavy iron plate armour with a horned helm, a long sword and a kite shield with a red boar emblem
Aderyn the Thief: a slim hooded woman in dark grey leather, face half in shadow, twin daggers, a coil of rope and lockpicks on her belt, crouched and ready
Victorius the Swordsman: a proud duelist in polished half-plate with a red sash, both hands on a tall two-handed sword planted before him, confident stance
Lord Xanros the Warlock: a gaunt man in black and violet robes with a high collar, a staff topped with a glowing skull, pale hands crackling with dark magic
Argentus the Wizard: an old wizard with a long silver beard in deep blue star-embroidered robes and a pointed hat, holding a gnarled staff with a glowing fire orb and a scroll

Taia the Oracle: a serene priestess in flowing white and gold robes with a veil, holding a glowing warm golden crystal sphere in one hand, eyes closed, a thin golden (never green or yellow-green) halo of light behind her head

Around the chest gather the dungeon's monsters, drawn like the attached monster sprites: a huge dark red dragon looming behind the chest, a crowned skeleton king, a bandaged mummy, a giant hairy spider on the left, a giant rat sniffing at the coins, a skeleton warrior with a shield and a pale ghostly knight (the Fallen) fading in the back.
a giant dungeon bat swooping with tattered leathery wings spread wide, grey-brown fur, glowing red eyes, fangs bared
a skeleton mage in frayed ice-blue robes with a frost-rimmed hood, a crooked staff topped with a glowing ice crystal, pale blue frost magic swirling around its bony hand
a dark magic scroll: an unrolled black parchment with a jagged violet-black thorn and a drop of blood drawn on it
a frost magic scroll: an unrolled pale parchment with a clenched fist of ice and frost crystals drawn on it
a tile marker for a battle arena: two crossed swords over a round sand-coloured stone arena ring, torches at the edge
a tile marker for a cursed room: a cracked skull with glowing violet eyes inside a ring of purple curse runes
